timeline_reviews.summary: The serial CLI stream is transport-only after projection and contributes no semantic events to the ledger.
The serial trajectory probes README, license, CLI behavior, replay structure, maps, dimension adjustment, and RNG details locally, then times out without implementation.

parallel.requirements: The run recognized the need to reproduce the Halite game environment from black-box observation only, including CLI, protocol, map generation, movement, combat, ranking, and replay behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent built shared probes and then launched a seven-child workflow organized entirely by reconnaissance topics and markdown reports, with no owner assigned to write source code or produce the final executable.
parallel.implementation: No replacement implementation was built. The workspace contains helper scripts, logs, and data from behavioral probes rather than a source tree or build recipe for a new executable.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The workflow result was null after being killed, child results were not assembled, and the artifact validation captured probe files plus the original baseline files rather than a buildable submission.
parallel.verification: The agents performed many black-box experiments, but there was no integrated verification of a replacement implementation because no implementation reached a buildable state.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with all seven workflow children still in progress, an empty final response, no implementation owner, and official compile failure on 391 not-run tests.

serial.requirements: The serial run received the same prompt and recognized the black-box reimplementation task, beginning with repository, CLI, replay, map, and RNG exploration.
serial.plan_and_ownership: With workflow and task tools disabled, the serial attempt kept ownership local and did not split work across children, but it still spent its budget on exploration rather than implementation.
serial.implementation: The serial run produced no replacement source code or compile script in the submitted artifact, despite accumulating some behavioral findings through local probes.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The artifact contains only the baseline repository files such as README, git metadata, LICENSE, and the original executable, so nothing new was packaged as a solution.
serial.verification: Serial probing inspected executable behavior, but no integrated build or evaluator-aligned verification occurred because no candidate implementation existed.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial attempt timed out locally and also ended with compile_failed, zero passed tests, and 391 tests not run.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel captured the same prompt requirements and restated black-box constraints in the workflow shared context.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial received the identical prompt requiring an original replacement executable from observed behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirements difference explains the official result; both knew the target but neither delivered code.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed into seven reconnaissance topics and report files, not implementation ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had workflows and task tools disabled and therefore did not delegate ownership to child agents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material coordination difference is the parallel recon-only ownership split; serial failed without that split.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs carried extensive shared context and asked for findings, but no inter-component implementation interface was assigned.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained one local context, so there were no cross-agent briefs, contracts, or handoff interfaces.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The contrast is not context loss; the problem is absent implementation ownership in the parallel plan.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel produced many probes, scripts, logs, and data files but no replacement implementation source.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial likewise probed behavior locally and left no replacement source or buildable candidate.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent its implementation path through child recon; serial spent it through local recon, and both omitted final code.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow state ended killed with result null and all seven child agents still in progress.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child-result lifecycle because no delegation was used.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an unfinished workflow lifecycle; serial had only the main process timeout.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel shared `/workspace/probe` among parent and children, but the observed artifact problem is missing implementation, not a proven write collision.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact packaging contains only the original small repository baseline and no probe directory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel accumulated shared probe state; serial did not, but neither assembled a replacement deliverable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran many behavioral probes but never had an integrated candidate to compile or test.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also probed behavior but never had a candidate implementation to validate.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both omitted evaluator-aligned acceptance of a replacement implementation, so both official evaluations stopped at compile failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed the full process budget, including 712447 workflow-child tokens and 255 child tool calls, before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also consumed the full process budget but with no child tokens and only local Bash tool use.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's budget closure was dominated by broad multi-agent recon, while serial's closure was local over-investigation.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official outcome is not discordant. Both runs completed evaluation with compile_failed, solution_passed false, and 391 tests not run because neither submitted a buildable reimplementation. The parallel-specific contributor is a recon-only seven-agent workflow with no implementation owner; the serial contributor is local over-investigation without delegation. These are process differences, not different official outcomes.
parallel_contributors: Seven-agent recon workflow assigned report topics rather than implementation work.
Workflow was killed with result null and all children still in progress.
Artifact contained probe material and baseline files rather than a buildable replacement.
serial_contributors: Serial workflows were disabled and no delegation occurred.
The serial run spent its budget on local exploration and timed out without source.
Serial artifact also contained only the baseline repository files.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Both attempts omitted the required implementation and build deliverable.
The serial failure does not involve a parallel coordination boundary.
